title: Exercise every story lifecycle state and preserve retirement history

steps.action: Create stories and move them through proposed, accepted, deferred, rejected, and retired lifecycle paths.
steps.expected_result: Every allowed state is projected from its append-only event head.

steps.action: Attempt each lifecycle transition the contract forbids.
steps.expected_result: Every invalid transition fails without writing an event.

steps.action: Open a retired story and its history.
steps.expected_result: The story is absent from the current accepted set while all definitions and events remain inspectable.

expected_result: Proposed, accepted, deferred, rejected, and retired transitions are visible, valid transitions succeed, invalid transitions fail, and retirement preserves the complete record.
